label: Archive room · synthetic fitting experiment

metrics.geometry_evaluation: Known synthetic geometry supplied, not estimated; no real-scene geometry benchmark.
metrics.evaluation_caveat: Same renderer generates and fits targets; this is an optimizer smoke test, not an independent photogrammetry benchmark.

limitations: Synthetic capture: camera poses and geometry are supplied, not recovered from photos.
Only RGB is optimized; geometry, scales, and opacity are fixed.
Training and testing share the same renderer; scores do not predict real-scene performance.
No measurement or forensic accuracy claim.
